title: Layer-trace storage layout
purpose: Audit trail for User choice on how layer_trace is stored. Closes the shared-append vs per-run fork that complicates Run1 joins (F-101). Does not by itself authorize emitter code change — that is a separate Act/story.
formula_frozen: TRACE_LAYOUT := PER_RUN_FILE; path := f(run_id); ¬SHARED_APPEND_MEGASTORE; join := open(path(run_id)) (no cross-run filter required)

options_presented.label: A — per-run trace files
options_presented.meaning: Each run writes its own layer_trace file keyed by content run_id (e.g. results/layer_trace/{run_id}_layer_trace.jsonl or under the run folder). No shared append across runs. Joins use path+run_id equality, not filter-of-megastore.

options_presented.label: B — shared append file (status quo)
options_presented.meaning: Keep results/layer_trace/XAUUSD_layer_trace.jsonl as multi-run append; consumers filter by run_id / lt_* slice. Current forensic pain (F-101 folder vs content id).

options_presented.label: C — hybrid (shared file + per-run pointer/manifest)
options_presented.meaning: Keep shared append for write path but emit a per-run manifest/pointer listing byte range or filtered extract path. Middle ground; more moving parts.
options_presented.note: Inferred alternative — confirm if a different C was on the card.

options_note: A was User answer 2026-09-23. B is documented status quo. C is the natural third cell for audit completeness; if the original card used a different B/C wording, amend this artifact — choice A still stands.
next_act_if_authorized: Story: emitter writes per-run path under results/layer_trace/{run_id}_*.jsonl (or run folder)
Optional: one-time extract of Run1 slice from shared file into per-run path for forensics

related.F-101: folder name ≠ content run_id on Run1
